title: Cryptometer
desc: Pfund cryptometer glass wedge calibrated for paint hiding power, opacity constants, and wet film thickness evaluation.

title: Flat Bottom Hole (FBH) Blocks
desc: ASTM E127 / E428 reference test blocks verified for hole diameter, depth precision, and ultrasonic response sensitivity.

title: Impact Weight (Falling Dart)
desc: ASTM D2794 / ISO 6272 falling dart impact weights calibrated for mass, nose radius, and drop-height energy absorption.

title: Alcohol Meter / Analyzer
desc: Hydrometric and electronic breath/solution alcohol density meters verified with certified ethanol-water concentration standards.

title: Microscope (Above 100X)
desc: Optical magnification, field depth, and eyepiece reticle scale calibration using certified stage micrometers.

title: Color Matching Booth / Cabinet
desc: D65 daylight, TL84 store light, CWF, UV, and incandescent sources verified for spectral lux output and correlated color temperature.

title: Durometer Hardness Blocks
desc: Shore A, Shore D, and Shore OO reference rubber test blocks verified for hardness durometer gauge validation.

title: V1 & V2 Calibration Blocks
desc: ISO 2400 / EN 12223 ultrasonic flaw detector calibration blocks verified for geometry, arc radii, and beam angle index marks.

title: Tablet Hardness Tester
desc: Crush strength testing load cells calibrated in Newtons (N), Kiloponds (kp), and Strong-Cobb (SC) using calibrated deadweights.

title: Specific Gravity Balance
desc: Archimedean specific gravity kit and density balance verification using distilled water and high-purity immersion liquids.

title: Pendulum Hardness Tester
desc: König and Persoz pendulum damping testers calibrated for oscillation period, dampening count, and ball indenter radius.

title: AC/DC Current Probe
desc: Hall-effect and Rogowski current probes calibrated for ratio linearity, phase shift, and frequency response up to 1000A.

title: Lead Standards (Shielding)
desc: X-ray shielding lead sheet and barrier standards verified for lead equivalence (mmPb) and uniform radiographic density.

title: Air & Water Flow Meter
desc: Rotameters, variable-area flow meters, and hot-wire anemometers calibrated for volumetric liquid and gas flow velocities.

title: Soldering Station & Iron
desc: Lead-free soldering iron tip temperature verification (up to 480°C) and millivolt ESD ground leakage potential testing.

title: Current Calibration Coil
desc: 10-turn and 50-turn precision clamp meter multiplier coils calibrated for ampere-turns accuracy and heat dissipation.

title: Resilience Tester (Rebound)
desc: Schob-type rubber resilience elasticity testers verified for rebound angle, potential energy, and pendulum friction loss.

title: Taper Type Abrasion Tester
desc: Rotary platform Taber-type abrasion testers calibrated for disc rotational speed, turntable runout, and specimen contact load.

title: S42 Sand Paper Strip for Tester
desc: Calibrated sandpaper strips for Taber and scrub testers certified for abrasive grit particle distribution and thickness.

title: UV Radiometer / Light Meter
desc: UVA, UVB, and UVC radiometers calibrated for spectral irradiance (mW/cm²) against certified standard photodetectors.

title: Jointed Test Finger (IEC 60529)
desc: Precision articulated test probes calibrated for knuckle dimensions, bending angle stops, and 10N / 30N spring forces.

title: Wrist Strap & Footwear Tester
desc: Operator ESD ground testers calibrated for resistance cutoffs (750kΩ lower limit, 35MΩ upper limit) and megohm continuity.
